description: Acalabrutinib as monotherapy is recommended as an option for untreated chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) in adults either with a 17p deletion or TP53 mutation, or without a 17p deletion or TP53 mutation when fludarabine plus cyclophosphamide and rituximab (FCR), or bendamustine plus rituximab (BR), is unsuitable. It is recommended only if the company provides the drug according to the commercial arrangement.
